text:
mina: Im booking a trip to Amsterdam for a customer workshop. A few awkward items: 1) my partner is coming but paying their own way  can I book a shared room and have the company cover my half? 2) I need a mandatory yellow-fever vaccine for a follow-up trip later this year  are immunizations reimbursable? 3) the hotel invoice includes VAT and a separate tourism tax line  can we reclaim VAT or do I claim gross? 4) childcare cost at home while I travel (night nanny for one night)  reimbursable? 5) I sometimes get hotel folios that are in Dutch and have weird line items  is a translation needed?

liz (People Ops): Good set of Qs. Short version: 1) If partner pays their own share you can book a shared room and request reimbursement only for your prorated portion. Make sure the booking shows split or add a note with the partner name and amount. Manager preapproval is recommended for shared-room bookings. 2) Mandatory immunizations required for business travel (company-mandated) are reimbursable if pre-approved by your manager and supported by medical receipt. Personal travel vaccines are not. 3) For EU VAT: keep the original invoice. Finance will handle VAT reclaim only for eligible business expenses; often VAT is reclaimable for hotels and some services if the invoice is in company name. If the invoice is in your name, finance will process as a gross reimbursement and will not reclaim VAT. Attach the original invoice and any booking confirmation. 4) Childcare is reimbursable only under limited circumstances: overnight childcare while traveling for an approved overnight business trip may be eligible up to policy limits with manager sign-off. Daycare at home is not covered. 5) Non-English folios are fine; upload the original and, if helpful, a short English note mapping key charges (room rate, VAT, city tax). Finance occasionally requests a translated line-item view for audits.

mina: for #1 the booking site only issues a single confirmation. can i just add a note?

anna (Travel): Yes add a note in the expense and attach proof of partner payment if possible (screenshot of transfer or payment confirmation). If your partner reimburses you after the trip, include the Venmo/transfer screenshot.

mina: vaccine receipts are from a clinic here. should i get manager pre-approval first?

liz (People Ops): Yes get manager pre-approval  we need confirmation it's business-mandated. Put the approval in the expense notes or attach the Slack thread/email. Save the clinic invoice (itemized) and any vaccine card entry.

josh (Finance): VAT nuance: hotels in Netherlands often show VAT + city tax. If the invoice is in company name and includes VAT number, we can reclaim. If not, we reimburse gross and you are not out-of-pocket for VAT specifically. For refunds/adjustments, include the original and corrected invoice. For childcare: include manager note and any receipts with provider info and dates.

mina: what about a small "service fee" on my credit card (card issuer conversion or cross-border fee)?
josh (Finance): Card foreign transaction fees are not reimbursable. We reimburse billed amounts converted to USD at the transaction posting rate, but bank fees are personal. If you require a corporate card for foreign travel to avoid fees, request one via Travel Ops before booking.

mina: and if the hotel provides a breakdown but in Dutch, i'll add a quick note mapping lines. cool. last: timeline for VAT reclaim if finance files it?
josh (Finance): VAT reclaim timing varies by country; if Finance reclaims VAT it may take several months. Your reimbursement will be processed as usual; if VAT is later refunded to the company we will reconcile and not typically retro-ask employees for money back unless it materially changes reimbursement. We'll note any reclaimed VAT in the expense record.

people-ops-bot: Travel & expense policy: https://redwoodintranet.company/travel-policy See sections: "Shared-room bookings", "Business-mandated medical costs", "EU VAT", and "Childcare during travel".

mina: thanks all. i'll ping my manager for approval and post the booking here when done. :)
